results.title: The Rose in Potato Hack: Why It Fails
results.description:
While widely shared on social media as a low-cost innovation, scientific evidence reveals that sticking cuttings into tubers is largely a horticultural myth that often leads to failure.
In this video, we explore the Potato Method. You will understand the real story behind this viral gardening hack and why it fails, based on factual events.
In this video you will discover: 
• Why decomposing potatoes create anaerobic conditions and harbor pathogens that cause rot. 
• How science-backed techniques like sterile rooting media and hormones offer higher success rates. 
• Why any perceived success is usually due to luck or natural plant resilience, not the potato.
Ultimately, for reliable propagation, you should rely on proven scientific methods rather than internet folklore.
